messages:
eva: FYI forwarding note from forwarder — 12 units held at FRA customs, manifest shows serials don't match the invoice. They9re asking us to hold invoice until reconciliation. This blocks replacement RMAs. Any quick wins for getting air expedited? :warning:

julie: which PO/AWB? can we cross-check against the depot manifest?

eva: AWB: 123-4567890. PO is RW-2026-342. Forwarder attached `manifest.csv` but several serials look truncated.

matt: on it. running quick lookup against staging inventory:```
# grep RW-2026-342 /opt/inventory/staging/serials.txt
SN: H100-5643-XX mismatch -> expected H100-5643-XY
SN: H100-5644-AB OK
SN: H100-5645-?? corrupted
```

andrew: if customs wants invoice holdback we have two options: 1) vendor re-issue invoice with corrected serial list (slow), 2) partial air-expedite for the confirmed-good serials and post an escrow note for the disputed ones. Vendor cost for option 2? :thinking_face:

vendor-liu: We can do partial air for up to 8 units same-day from FRA to NL depot. Cost for expedite freight + paperwork: EUR 1,950 total. We will also provide notarized serial reconciliation PDF within 24h. For the remaining 4 units forwarder recommends hold+inspection or return-to-supplier.

eva: 1,950 EUR — ok can we absorb from the provisioning cushion? This is to keep customer infra online.

julie: provisioning cushion has ~EUR 4,200 remaining this quarter. Approve partial expedite and ask vendor for signed correction?

andrew: approve from ops cushion. also ask vendor to confirm RMA routing: expedite -> NL depot (depot accepts air arrivals and will stage replacements), held units -> FRA inspection -> RMA if DOA. Add SLA: 48h for NL staging.

vendor-liu: Confirmed. Route: expedite AWB 123-4567890-B (new); NL depot intake SLA 48h; FRA inspection ETA 36-72h to determine RMA. We will push notarized serial list by EOD.

ops-bot: deploy-log: created ticket OPS-8243 to track expedite payment, AWB split, and customs docs. Link: https://redwood-internal/ops/OPS-8243 :white_check_mark:

matt: leaving a note — please include the forwarder9s reconciliation CSV in the ticket, I9ll attach the grep output and the staging snapshot.

eva: thanks all. andrew, can you initiate the payment for the EUR 1,950 expedite and cc finance? we9ll close once notarized list is in the ticket. :thumbsup:
